pages.text: The Screen Link stores the location of a $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/screen)Screen$(/l) so a $(l:rftoolsbase:tools/tablet)Tablet$(/l) can open that screen remotely.

pages.title: Linking
pages.text: Right-click a Screen with the Screen Link to store it. Right-clicking a non-screen block clears the stored target.

pages.title: Tablet
pages.text: Put the link in a Tablet. Using the tablet opens the remote screen if the screen's chunk is loaded. Sneak-use opens the tablet interface.
